title: Varnholm Town History
text:
Varnholm is a small river town in the fictional Kestrel Valley. It was founded in 1847 by the miller Edda Larsk, who built a grain mill on the east bank of the Silvane River. The settlement grew quickly after a stone bridge was completed in 1861.

The Varnholm town hall was built in 1902 from local red sandstone and still houses the municipal council. According to the 2020 census, Varnholm had a population of 12,400 people. The town is best known for its annual Lantern Fair.

title: Kestrel-9 Battery Datasheet Summary
text:
The Kestrel-9 is a sodium-ion battery module manufactured by Orvane Labs and released in March 2023. It is designed for stationary grid storage rather than vehicles.

The Kestrel-9 has an energy density of 165 Wh/kg. It retains 80 percent of its original capacity after 4,000 full charge cycles. The module operates between -30 and 55 degrees Celsius and does not use cobalt or lithium.

title: Field Notes: The Aurelian Moth
text:
The Aurelian moth (Lepidia aurelia) is a fictional night-flying moth found only in the Halden Highlands. Adults have a wingspan of 6 to 7 centimetres and golden forewings with two dark spots.

Adult Aurelian moths feed on the nectar of night-blooming tobacco flowers. They are active from late June to August, and an adult moth lives for about 12 days. Females lay their eggs on the underside of tobacco leaves.

title: Brightwater Reservoir
text:
Brightwater Reservoir was completed in 1968 to supply drinking water to Varnholm and two neighbouring towns. It is managed by the Kestrel Valley Water Authority.

The reservoir has a storage capacity of 48 million cubic metres. Its concrete gravity dam is 61 metres high and 410 metres long. Swimming in the reservoir is prohibited, but fishing is allowed with a permit.

title: The Quillon Messaging Protocol
text:
Quillon is a fictional lightweight messaging protocol created by the engineer Mara Ostberg in 2011. Quillon servers listen on TCP port 7425 by default.

A Quillon session starts with a three-step handshake: the client sends HELLO, the server replies with OFFER, and the client answers with CONFIRM. Individual Quillon messages are limited to 64 KB; larger payloads must be split into numbered fragments.

title: Halden Highlands Climate and Geography
text:
The Halden Highlands form the northern rim of the Kestrel Valley. The highest peak is Mount Tervel, which rises to 2,210 metres.

The highlands receive an average annual rainfall of 1,340 millimetres. Snow usually covers the upper slopes from December to March. The region is home to several rare insects, including the Aurelian moth.

title: Orvane Labs Company Profile
text:
Orvane Labs is a fictional energy-storage company founded in 2015 and headquartered in the city of Tessaly. Its chief executive officer is Ilse Marrow. The company employs 340 people.

Orvane Labs makes two product lines. The Kestrel-9 is a sodium-ion module for grid storage, while the Kestrel-12 is a lithium iron phosphate module with an energy density of 140 Wh/kg intended for electric buses.

title: The Varnholm Lantern Fair
text:
The Lantern Fair has been held in Varnholm since 1889. It takes place on the second weekend of October each year and attracts about 30,000 visitors.

The highlight of the fair is the evening procession in which paper lanterns are floated down the Silvane River. Local bakers sell spiced pear bread during the fair.
